title: Skydive Sebastian
specs: Only drop zone on the Florida Atlantic coastline
Jump altitude around 13,500 feet with about 60 seconds freefall
Canopy ride lasts 5-6 minutes with views of Florida Treasure Coast and Sebastian Inlet
Must be 18 years or older to sign waiver and participate
Must weigh no more than 230 pounds for tandem skydive
Must weigh no more than 220 pounds for AFF student skydive
Must be in good health and physical shape
Must bring valid photo ID (driver's license or passport)
AFF students must be between 18-59 years old

options.name: Accelerated Freefall Course (AFF)
options.detail: Learn to skydive with an 8-level USPA certified program including first student jump

services.name: Tandem Skydive
services.desc: Enjoy a visit to one of the most beautiful parts of the Florida coastline and experience the thrill of your lifetime! Our professional jumpmasters’ experience level exceeds thousands of tandem skydives and our skydiving center has maintained one of the best safety records in the sport. Our professional and friendly staff will make your skydive unforgettable! They are seasoned instructors who know how to answer your questions and will go out of their way to be sure you enjoy everything about your first skydive. includes: Tandem parachute container with main and reserve parachutes
Instruction and ground school before jump
gap: Exact duration of Accelerated Freefall course not stated
blurb: Guests can experience tandem skydiving from 13,500 feet with about 60 seconds of freefall and 5-6 minutes under canopy, enjoying views of the Florida Treasure Coast and Sebastian Inlet. The facility also offers an Accelerated Freefall (AFF) program for those wanting to learn to skydive independently. The drop zone is located on the Atlantic Coastline, providing unique coastal views during the jump.
extraNote: Weather can delay jumps; few days prevent jumping all day · Waiver is a binding contract and must be signed by participant · Accept all major credit cards
